description: This file defines the WorkWeekModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It models the work week with properties for each day, implements serialization traits, and constructs the model from a WorkWeek entity.

classes.name: WorkWeekModel
classes.description: A model class representing the work week schedule, used for API serialization within the OrangeHRM Leave module.
